Ninja Catalogue

A focused catalogue for Orb Arena combatants. Import/export stays in HTML, and legacy details are preserved when you edit an existing ninja.

Keep only the information useful for Orb Arena visible: combat identity, loadout, special abilities, and D100 stats. HTML import/export preserves the complete record, including legacy fields hidden from this streamlined editor.

Create Orb Arena Ninja

Required core: name, weapon/tool, Jutsu 1, Jutsu 2, Ultimate Jutsu, relevant lineage/abilities, and all D100 combat stats. Type, rank, village, and clan help identify the fighter and trigger specific arena behavior.

D100 Stats

Set each individual stat from 1–100 for this ninja. These values are saved with the Catalogue entry.

Ninja Development

Use this independent system to develop an existing ninja through training, combat, new techniques, chakra development, ability growth, recovery, setbacks, and breakthroughs. It does not advance the Character Creation Wheel.

1. Existing Ninja

Load a generated/logged ninja, or enter an existing ninja manually. All fields remain editable before development.

Current D100 Stats

2. Abilities & Knowledge

Choose the ninja's current abilities from the same structured option pools used by the generator. Add additional selections wherever the ninja can possess multiple abilities.

Refreshing is useful after loading additional canon catalogues.
